text: …　ポケモンは　かち　まけ　じゃ　ないわ

structure.jp: かち　まけ　じゃ　ないわ

patterns.name: 〜じゃない
patterns.span: かち　まけ　じゃ　ない
patterns.explanation: じゃない after a thing says 'is not that thing'. かち まけ じゃ ない = 'isn't winning or losing'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence gives it a soft, feminine tone. かち まけ じゃ ないわ = 'it isn't about winning or losing'.
